brief: How we orchestrate 12 agents in production. Tools, patterns, gotchas.

slots.title: 1. Router, the Gatekeeper
slots.body: We route requests via a central LLM router that picks the right model based on latency, cost, and capability constraints.

slots.title: 2. State, the Single Source
slots.body: Postgres locks agent state, checkpoints memory, and prevents race conditions when multiple workers touch the same thread.

slots.title: 3. Workers, the Async Queue
slots.body: Redis Streams fan out tasks to twelve specialized workers with consumer groups, backpressure, and dead-letter retries built in.

slots.title: 4. Tools, the API Mesh
slots.body: Every agent calls typed tools via an internal tRPC mesh with schema validation, timeouts, and circuit breakers enforced upstream.

slots.title: 5. Evals, the Guardrails
slots.body: We run 200+ pytest evals on every deploy: hallucination checks, tool-call accuracy, and output schema compliance against golden sets.

slots.title: 6. Logs, the Flight Recorder
slots.body: Structured traces ship to Loki with span IDs linking LLM calls, tool executions, and state diffs for instant replay.
